_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#1, #2, #6, #15, dune::poisson_mms#4, dune::heat#2 and dune::time_dependent_heat#1 — grouped because they are all statements about ONE thing, the JIT cache, and splitting them would multiply C++ builds for no extra evidence. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 27 s of which ~22 s is the one deliberate cold build: getDunePyDir() -> <sys.prefix>/.cache/dune-py with the modules under python/dune/generated, and ~/.dune does not exist. A form carrying a never-before-seen float literal printed 'DUNE-INFO: Compiling Integrands (new)', took 21.97 s at nx=4 and then 0.046 s and 0.044 s at nx=8 and nx=16 — the same module serves every resolution, which is the poisson_mms#4 / heat#2 'only the first level pays' claim in one measurement. In-process: changing dune.ufl.Constant.value re-solved in 0.0002 s and added no .so; re-building the identical form took 0.0055 s and added no .so; ufl.Constant(1.0) with no domain raises AttributeError. Re-creating the scheme every step cost 46x reusing it over 20 steps (0.072 s vs 0.0016 s) WITHOUT any re-JIT, so that ratio is the floor of the time_dependent_heat#1 penalty, not the ceiling. COST WARNING for whoever maintains this: the cold observation mints a fresh literal from the wall clock on every run, so each run pays one build and leaves one .so behind. A SECOND trap was found while writing this fixture and is why nothing here re-creates spaces in a loop: re-creating grid+space+scheme repeatedly inside one process eventually recompiles a UFLLocalFunction for a form already built in that same process (measured: three identical passes over nx=4,8,16 were free on passes 1 and 2, then compiled 47.5 s and 50.9 s modules on pass 3). Build each grid, space and scheme once and reuse it. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 puts a never-before-seen FLOAT LITERAL into the form that the base run rebuilds identically, so the cache cannot serve it. It is the same trigger this fixture measures in its cold run, applied to the warm one, and it costs one extra C++ build under mutation only. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'identical_form_is_free=True', 'dune_jit_cache_and_rebuild_triggers_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
